---
name: Hardware report
about: Tell me how the test build runs on your PS Vita / PS TV (good or bad, both help!)
title: "[Hardware] "
labels: hardware-test
---

**Console:** PS Vita 1000 (OLED) / PS Vita 2000 (slim) / PS TV
**Firmware and HENkaku setup:** (e.g. 3.65 Enso, 3.74 HENlo)
**Overclocked?** (e.g. PSVshell / none)
**Which VPK:** APlaceBeyond.vpk / APlaceBeyond-bootlog.vpk

**Does it start?** yes / no (what do you see?)

**How does it run?** (smooth / a bit slow / very slow — and where: title, forest, parish, the lake, a stage, the dream...)

**Graphics:** anything wrong? (missing textures, wrong colours, flickering, black screen, garbage) — a photo helps

**Sound:** music and effects OK?

**Saves:** CONTINUE works after quitting? Did you bring a PSP save over?

**Companions** (hired in the Quiet Room): did they work for you?

**Crash or freeze?** What were you doing?

**boot.txt** (if you used the boot-log build): attach `ux0:data/APlaceBeyond/boot.txt` here (drag the file in).
